# Rise With Media

> Rise With Media is a full-service digital marketing agency in Krishnagiri and Hosur, Tamil Nadu, India. Specializing in Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram advertising), viral Instagram Reels production, custom high-speed websites, local SEO, and WhatsApp CRM business automation across South India.

## Geographic Service Regions
- **Primary Hubs**: Krishnagiri (Headquarters), Hosur (Industrial & Tech Hub), Dharmapuri, Salem, Bengaluru (Bangalore), Chennai.

- **Remote / Global**: Serving remote businesses worldwide for web engineering, paid ads, and SaaS automation.

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Social Media Marketing & Reels Video Production
- Strategic content planning customized for consumer brands, retail, healthcare, real estate, and education.
- Scroll-stopping Instagram Reels and short-form video shooting & editing engineered for algorithmic reach.
- Color grading, dynamic sound design, scripting, and organic audience growth.

### 2. Performance Marketing & Meta Ads
- Full-funnel Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns engineered for profitable ROAS (5.3x average client ROAS).
- Hyperlocal B2B and B2C lead generation for showrooms, clinics, schools, real estate projects, and local stores in Krishnagiri, Hosur, Salem, Dharmapuri, and Bengaluru.
- Meta Pixel, Conversions API (CAPI), and automated WhatsApp click-to-chat lead routing.

### 3. Website Design & Conversion Funnels
- Mobile-first, ultra-fast responsive business websites and corporate platforms.
- High-converting landing pages tailored for ad campaigns and immediate lead capture.
- SEO-ready semantic HTML, clean UI/UX, and Cloudflare edge hosting.

### 4. Local SEO & Search Engine Optimization
- Google Business Profile optimization to rank in the Local 3-Pack on Google Maps for Krishnagiri, Hosur, and regional searches.
- Technical SEO, structured schema markup (JSON-LD), and high-intent regional keyword targeting.

### 5. SaaS Platforms & WhatsApp Automation
- **Agency OS**: Centralized multi-branch lead routing, staff task tracking, and operations software.
- **WhatsApp Cloud Automation**: Automated lead alerts, proposal delivery, and customer follow-ups via WhatsApp API.

## Verified Results & Case Highlights
- **Krin Brin School**: Scaled admissions and revenue from 0 to 4L monthly within 90 days.
- **Saranya Elite Bridal Studio**: Generated high-intent bridal bookings within 2 weeks of Meta ad launch.
- **Atros India & Hsieh Hsu India**: Industrial B2B platforms engineered for domestic and international machinery export inquiries.
- **Valsii Official, Arunam Catering, Richi Foods, Chocodor**: Local consumer brands scaled with viral short-form content and performance ads.
